coordinate_system: Metres; X forward from robot bases, Y left, Z up. Quaternions in pilot.json and reset states are XYZW; geometry orientations are WXYZ.
shape_size_convention: Box sizes are HALF extents; cylinders use radius and half length. fromto lists segment endpoints, capsules add their endcap radius. Mesh vertices, scale, orientation and offset define the visual bounds. Shapes are body-local; bodies are asset-local.

station.robot: Two native YAM arms with parallel finger grippers, geometry from the pinned yam-arena dependency. Table and camera stand are rigid station fixtures.

nominal_materials.wood: Brown shelves, rests and cover frame; wooden tray/cover.
nominal_materials.polymer: Blue receiving pads and green marker; battery casing and screwdriver handle.
nominal_materials.metal: Clamp base, pivot, spring and lever; screwdriver shaft and blade; sealed tray tins.
nominal_materials.paper_and_board: Books, represented by rigid bodies with retained texture.

material_scope: Nominal visual material labels, not measured constitutive properties. Rigid contact uses per-shape friction or the defaults in the bundled USD authoring code; no fracture, deformation, electronics or fluids.
